intro.title: Color Picker
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build an interactive color picker component that allows users to select colors from a palette and see real-time previews. You'll learn how to use Angular's reactive forms and two-way data binding to capture user input and update the UI dynamically. The project will teach you essential Angular concepts including component communication, event handling, and property binding while working with HTML color input elements and CSS styling. You'll also explore how to manage component state and emit custom events to share the selected color with parent components. By the end of this lesson, you'll have a fully functional color picker that demonstrates core Angular patterns for building interactive user interfaces.
intro.usecase: Color pickers are essential components in design tools like Canva, Figma, and Adobe Creative Suite, where users need to select colors for text, shapes, and backgrounds. They appear in content management systems and website builders like WordPress and Wix, enabling users to customize themes and brand colors. E-commerce platforms use color pickers in product customization features, allowing customers to preview items in different colors before purchase. Social media platforms and messaging apps implement color pickers for user interface personalization, story creation, and custom emoji reactions.
